widget.name: React Email Editor
widget.description: React Email Editor based on Unlayer's wrapper component available at https://github.com/unlayer/react-email-editor.

property.caption: JSON Template (String)
property.description: JSON design (as a string), loaded into the editor and written back when the design is saved.

property.caption: HTML (String)
property.description: Optional. Receives the exported HTML whenever the design is saved.

property.caption: Write changes to attributes
property.description: Write the design (and HTML) to the attributes while the user edits, so a regular Save button on the page stores them. No action is executed.

property.caption: Unlayer project ID
property.description: Project ID from the Unlayer Developer Console. Required for production use; 0 leaves it unset.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Minimum height of the editor, as a CSS length (for example 700px or 80vh). Unlayer recommends at least 700px.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Appearance of the editor.

property.caption: Locale
property.description: Optional. Editor language, for example en-US, nl-NL or pt-PT. Leave empty for English.

property.caption: Advanced options (JSON)
property.description: Optional. Extra Unlayer editor options as a JSON object, for example {"tools": {"html": {"enabled": false}}, "features": {"stockImages": false}}. See https://docs.unlayer.com.

property.caption: Show Export HTML Button
property.description: Show or hide the Export HTML button in the toolbar.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Caption of the Export HTML button.

property.caption: Export HTML
property.description: Action to handle the built HTML email body.

property.caption: Show Save Template Button
property.description: Show or hide the Save Template button in the toolbar.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Caption of the Save Template button.

property.caption: Save JSON Template
property.description: Action to Save JSON template as a string. The attributes are written before it runs.

property.caption: Merge tags
property.description: Optional. Placeholders offered in the editor's merge tag menu, for example Mendix email template placeholders such as {%Name%}.

property.caption: Name
property.description: Label shown in the merge tag menu.

property.caption: Value
property.description: Text inserted into the design, for example '{%' + $currentObject/Name + '%}'.

property.caption: Sample
property.description: Optional. Value shown instead of the tag while previewing.

property.caption: Image uploads
property.description: Where images that users upload are stored. Unlayer's storage is outside this application.

property.caption: Upload URL
property.description: Endpoint that receives the image as multipart/form-data (part "file") and responds with JSON {"url": "..."}, for example rest/emaileditor/v1/images.
